play_mix.method: Provider rushingPlays.rate and passingPlays.rate on offense and defense; garbage time excluded
play_mix.ranking: Descending frequency among FBS teams; #1 means highest share, not best
play_mix.denominator: CFBD total plays, including other classifications; rush and pass shares may sum to less than 100%

yardage.method: Season team yardage totals / games, completions or carries; provider Line Yards per rush excludes garbage time.
yardage.rank: Higher offense and lower defense rank first among the existing FBS team universe.

scoring_form.method: Completed regular-season scoreboard points; last five completed games with available CFBD closing lines.
